Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 21 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 24 September 2025(Wednesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac, Pampanga, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Rizal, Quezon and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
